listing.name: Final Fantasy Fables: Chocobo’s Dungeon (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Player-managed Wii disc preparation on Windows and a windowed upstream source build on Linux.

steps.title: Prepare the Windows player
steps.instruction: For an already permitted Windows x64 copy, keep its DLLs beside chocobo.exe. Place your own NTSC-U R7FEGD ISO or CISO in that folder, or supply the matching extracted sys and files under extracted. Start chocobo.exe and allow the upstream extraction to finish.

steps.title: Build the windowed Linux player from your original
steps.instruction: Follow the tagged upstream build instructions in a source tree you are permitted to use. Obtain sys/main.dol from your own matching extracted disc and run the documented Python recompilation into a clean gen directory. Build the windowed USE_SDL=ON target with CMake, Ninja, a C++17 compiler, SDL2 and OpenGL development libraries.

steps.title: Keep each profile with its actual root
steps.instruction: Use the upstream player with the matching extracted sys and files. With the standard layout preserve extracted, nand and chocobo.ini beside the creating runtime. The Windows player also accepts an explicit extracted-folder path, where save placement can follow that external root. Preserve the actual data locations before switching layouts.
